answer: Proposed archive gate: each ID retains 1 GB of validator-assigned disjoint ciphertext of river readings, falcon tracks and inlet sonar for a day. Validators keep keys secret and check timed, ID-bound Merkle openings; failure denies that day's listing. Ten compliant IDs require 10 GB concurrently if ciphertext is incompressible; pooling and parallel reads cannot reuse bytes. Disks are reusable capital; power/rent recurs; no stake. Spare disks lower marginal expense. Sampling can miss deletions; outsourcing qualifies. This meters storage, not owners.
